headline: Adopted a 0% tax shift for Fiscal Year 2027 on a 7–2 vote; upheld the Chair's ruling on a point of order.

plain_text:
City of Fitchburg  
                   Massachusetts  01420  
 
                   CITY COUNCIL  
           
    
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
The Special Meeting of the City Council was held in the Legislative Building, 700 Main Street, 
and called to order by President Anthony Zarrella at 7:12 PM. The Salute to the Flag was led by  
Councilor Fleming. The City Clerk called the roll, nine  (9) Councilors were present, Councilor 
Cragin and Green were absent.  
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 
I. PUBLIC FORUM 
 
This meeting will be open to the public.  Persons who wish to participate remotely in the Public 
Forum portion of the meeting may request a remote attendance link by contacting the City Clerk 
at cityclerk@fitchburgma.gov.   
 
There was not public comment made. 
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 
President Zarrella read the Warrant for the Special Meeting. 
  
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 
President Zarrella declared the Tax Classification hearing opened at 7:14 PM 
 
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 Assessors Chris Paquette and Ryan Beauvais were present to answer questions from the City 
Council. 
The Assessors reported that sales data had been collected and verified for the period of January 
1, 2025, through December 31, 2025, with a 24-month analysis used for certain property classes. 
The results indicated that residential property values continued to increase, while commercial 
and industrial property values experienced modest increases. 
During the previous fiscal year, permits were issued for eight new single-family homes, four 
duplexes, one three-family dwelling, and three new multi-unit buildings totaling 45 units. 
The total taxable value for Fiscal Year 2027 was certified at $5,594,721,844, representing a 
4.18% increase over the previous fiscal year. Because residential property values increased at a

greater rate than commercial and industrial property values, a slight shift in the distribution of 
assessed values among property classes continued. 
The certified new growth levy was $690,202, reflecting continued investment in the real estate 
market and ongoing efforts to improve the accuracy of real and personal property valuations. 
New growth added $51,933,886 in value to the City's tax base, distributed as follows: 
• Residential property: 35.9% 
• Commercial property: 3.5% 
• Industrial property: 1.8% 
• Personal property: 58.8% 
Fitchburg's Fiscal Year 2027 property tax levy limit was reported as $73,882,027, representing a 
3.46% increase over the Fiscal Year 2026 actual levy. Based on the allowable 2.5% levy limit 
increase and additional new growth, the estimated single tax rate was $13.21 per $1,000 of 
assessed valuation. 
The Assessors referenced the FY2027 Tax Classification Hearing Booklet, which included 
analyses of tax rates, shift factors, tax levies, and other information relevant to the Council's 
determination of the Fiscal Year 2027 tax classification. 
The booklet is available at: 
Amended FY2027 Final Book – Tax Classification 
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 
Ms. Jacquelyn Wehtje spoke in opposition to maintaining the single tax rate, expressing concern 
that the residential tax burden has continued to increase rather than decrease as originally 
anticipated. The resident also raised concerns regarding housing affordability, tax incentive 
agreements, and the need for additional commercial and industrial development. 
 
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 
President Zarrella declared the Tax Classification hearing closed at 7:33 PM.  
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 
At 8:10 PM, Vice President Cruz raised a point of order concerning Councilor Beauchemin. 
Councilor Beauchemin appealed the ruling of the Chair. A motion was made and seconded to 
appeal the ruling. 
The Council proceeded to a vote on whether to overturn the ruling of the Chair. 
The appeal received one vote in favor and eight votes opposed. Voting in opposition were 
Councilor Bowen, Vice President Cruz, Councilor Fleming, Councilor Schultz, Councilor Starr, 
Councilor Van Hazinga, Councilor Walsh, and President Zarrella. 
The appeal failed by a vote of 1–8, and the ruling of the Chair was upheld. 
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
A motion was made and seconded to adopt a 0% tax shift for Fiscal Year 2027. 
The motion passed by a vote of 7–2, with Councilor Beacuhemin and Councilor Fleming voting 
in opposition. 
Nine members were present. The City Council consists of eleven members. 
 
 
The meeting adjourned at 8:26 P.M.

Joanna Bilotta-Simeone, City Clerk
